deviations.description: Extension-scanning loop's git -C "$REPO_ROOT" ls-files and relative-path stripping assumed $EXT_DIR lives inside $REPO_ROOT's own git worktree
deviations.reason: Not separately enumerated in the plan's task list, but required for the stated Goal to actually hold: without it, the synthetic external-source-store fixture exited 1 with 536 false absent findings because git ls-files against an absolute pathspec outside its own repo resolves nothing. Added EXT_GIT_ROOT (the git toplevel of $EXT_DIR, falling back to $REPO_ROOT) and routed the loop's three REPO_ROOT-relative computations through it.
